role: Makes an attacking wolf or ocelot leap at its target: when 2 to 4 blocks away, on the ground, and a 1-in-5 draw passes, adds the horizontal leap impulse and sets motionY.
scope_reason: Only EntityWolf and EntityOcelot register this task (grep over oracle/src), and world.conf forces wolves = off and ocelots = off, so it is never constructed, in the oracle too (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches').

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: the motionX/motionZ impulse and motionY = leapMotionY

notes: The double literal 0.800000011920929D is the widened float 0.4f*2 pattern; a future port must copy it as printed (AGENTS.md gotcha).
